## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

## Scope and evidence

- Affected components and contract/data implications:
- Commands actually run and results:
- Screenshots or permitted evidence-linked examples, when relevant:
- Unresolved limitations or review needs:

## Data changes, if applicable

Identify source/version, retrieval/hash, terms/attribution, time and spatial support,
unit conversions, missingness and before/after coverage. Preserve source conflicts
and unknown intervention status. Link exact document evidence and human review
status for extracted facts. Do not attach raw caches, credentials or model weights.

See [the contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[data guidance](../docs/research-data/contributing.md).

## Research studies, if applicable

Link the study and protocol; state status, question, data/code versions, reproduction
steps, measured versus planned results, limitations and the review scope requested.
Follow the [research guide](../research/CONTRIBUTING.md). Merging a study does not
establish scientific validation.
